text_block_list.text:
—The year is already drawing to a close. Christmas season has arrived.
As I head toward the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, I'm here to pick you up, Trainer.
Your fearless Santa has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nothing much, just thought I'd treat you
to a little present.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Shut up and follow me.
I thought I was gonna get dragged behind the gym... but we just headed back to the Trainer's room like normal.
Upon opening the door—

Her usually plain room...
was decorated in a Christmas style.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Take it.
Just a little gift from me.

"And what caught the eye above all else
was the lavish spread of food laid out on the side tables."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Teriyaki-style roast, a Christmas wreath salad, and a whole strawberry cake...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, this should do it.
Eat up and stuff yourself."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I made it, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ain't no need to look that surprised...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Even so, my mom gave me some serious cooking lessons, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Someone who can't even make their own food
is only half a person" ...is what I was told.

You can catch a glimpse of their character from those words.
They must be a truly reliable person.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But...
That's so lame...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... um...

Being good at household chores
is nothing to be ashamed of. When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that ain't it.
Sure, it's embarrassing, but more than that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Even though I can cook, it's pretty pathetic that I've never made anything for you until now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's just kinda embarrassing...
Being an outlaw, but having people think I'm all domestic...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I knew you weren't the type
to look down on me for that. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I felt pretty lame for not being able
to lay myself bare out there.
"Showing off a dish made with all her heart was probably Vodka's own way of taking on a challenge."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know if it'll suit your taste, got it?
No asking for a redo either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you just put
too much faith in me...
choice_data_list: We're in the same boat, aren't we?
We're in the same boat, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Guess so. Not like we need to sound each other out at this point, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, since we're usually running around like crazy,
let's kick back and enjoy ourselves today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Merry whatever, Trainer.
And, ya know... thanks for always being there...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now, first let's enjoy ourselves
with some Christmas dinner.
—After eating their fill.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it were before my debut,
this would have been enough, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guess that won't fly right now, huh.
Hey, Trainer, let's head out into town.
choice_data_list: What did you come here to do?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm handing out presents to my fans.

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Vodka!? Look, over there!
It's Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Vodka!! Merry Xmaaas!!
Give me some loooove!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Winks, blown kisses—take as many as you like!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm going all out today. That's why
I came all the way out here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah!!

Amidst the high-pitched cheers, Vodka walks calmly.
It's truly a sight to behold...

Vodka walked through town,
doing as much fan service as she could.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen to me, got it?
Keep what we just said about cooking an absolute secret.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, it's not 'cause I'm embarrassed!
Protecting kids' dreams is Santa's job too, you know!
